name: matt-loop
description: Matt Pocock design with the user via matt-design; confirmed-spec autonomous tickets, implementation, verification and independent review via matt-auto. Includes PR babysitting and conflict resolution. Requires weed-harness 6.0+.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborative Matt design and autonomous confirmed-spec execution
interface.longDescription: Use matt-design to iterate design decisions with the user and produce a confirmed local spec. Invoke matt-auto --spec separately to create tickets, implement, verify and independently review. design-map in weed-harness visualizes the current design. Optional flags enable PR shipping.
defaultPrompt: Use $matt-design to design this change with me.
Use $matt-auto --spec docs/design/feature.md to implement and review the confirmed design.
